parsed.internal_thinking: I have 2 Wood, 3 Sheep, 3 Wheat, and 1 Ore. Jimmy is at 4 VP and Claude has 2 Knights. I need to reach 5 VP. I have a Knight card ready to use if needed, but since the robber isn't on me and I want to save it for a crucial block or to contest Largest Army, I'll hold it. My current resources don't allow for a settlement (missing Brick) or a city (missing Ore). I'll try to trade Wheat for Ore to buy a Dev Card or Wheat for Brick to build toward a settlement. Since Jimmy is at 4 VP, I won't trade with him unless it's a steal. Claude is also a threat. I will propose a trade to Claude for Ore to try and get a Dev Card to potentially stop Jimmy or get a VP point.
